meta.title: Monthly climate averages for main destination cities (India Outbound Travel News)
meta.source: Open-Meteo Historical Weather API (archive-api.open-meteo.com/v1/archive), model era5_seamless (ERA5-Land temperature + ERA5 precipitation, ECMWF/Copernicus C3S reanalysis)
meta.licence: Data CC BY 4.0. Attribution required: 'Weather data by Open-Meteo.com' linking https://open-meteo.com/ ; underlying ERA5 / ERA5-Land: Copernicus Climate Change Service (C3S). Free API is for non-commercial use only (see open-meteo.com/en/terms).
meta.method: Daily temperature_2m_max, temperature_2m_min, precipitation_sum (local timezone) fetched per city. For each calendar month: avg_high_c = mean of daily max; avg_low_c = mean of daily min; rain_mm = mean monthly precipitation total across the 10 years; rain_days_1mm = mean count of days with >=1.0 mm; rain_mm_min/max = driest and wettest year for that month.
caveats: Reanalysis grid-cell values (ERA5 ~25 km for precipitation; ERA5-Land ~9-11 km for temperature), not station observations and not official WMO 1991-2020 normals.
Tropical convective rainfall and coastal/island cells (Male, Phuket, Langkawi, Singapore) can differ noticeably from station records; see validation in weather_seasons_plan.md.
10-year averages; single years vary widely (see rain_mm_min/max).
meta.validation_summary: See weather_seasons_plan.md section 3. Checked against MSS Singapore, JMA Tokyo, KTO Seoul/Busan, Dubai Media Office and Nepal Tourism Board figures.
